_comment: A constructed corpus for the one case neither sample corpus contains: ONE message (cluster_id CLU9) delivered as TWO rows (record_id ROW1, ROW2) because it carried two attachments. The data dictionary: record_id is 'one per row, so a message with two attachments gets two'; cluster_id is 'the originating MESSAGE, shared by every row and every triplet that came out of it'. Keyed on record_id this message is two groups and its twelve dead are stated twice. Keyed on cluster_id it is one. Run graph-chat/engine/bench/idcheck.py over this file to see the two keys disagree.
